﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229BD — exact double-primitive-triple gluing and scale elimination


STATUS: POST_229BC_DOUBLE_PRIMITIVE_TRIPLE_GLUE_PROVED / EXACT_INVERSE_BIJECTION_FOR_TWO_SQUARE_SELECTORS / MOVING_h_AND_d0_ELIMINATED_AS_INDEPENDENT_COORDINATES / PROVED_CROSS_GCD_2x2_MATRIX / PROVED_GSTAR_EQUALS_GCD_EH_XY / EXACT_PHYSICAL_HEIGHT_TRANSFER / SHARED_t_CONGRUENCE_ROUTER / NO_COUNTING_PROMOTION / GLOBAL_GATE_UNCHANGED / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_GLOBAL_REOPEN


TYPE: POST-229BC EXACT PHYSICAL REPARAMETERIZATION / NESTED PRIMITIVE PYTHAGOREAN GLUING / CONTENT-SCALE ELIMINATION / RADICAL SUPPORT CROSSWALK / COUNTING-MEASURE FIREWALL


OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY: M3-T11-229
LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION: M3-T11-228
PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA: Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229BC
PRIMARY_GATE: M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN
M3_T11_230: NOT ISSUED
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT: 0
CARD_DOC_ID: 1bhLi6btrt67FmxDVz5J4wItVPgulY322kwsAZcTUS1I


1. Exact scope


Define P_square(B) to consist of positive primitive integer physical quadruples
  (e,x,y,R), gcd(e,x,y)=1, R<=B,
  x^2+y^2=z^2,
  e^2+z^2=R^2,
with the two positive square roots z,R.


This is only the two-square-selector ambient receiver used by229D/229BC. Any further M3 host requirement (retained edge/face Pythagorean conditions, chamber, direction, canonical selector, sign or ordering) must be imposed as an explicit postfilter. No claim that arbitrary such quadruples are full M3 endpoints is made.


2. The two uniquely determined primitive triples


Let
  d0=gcd(x,y),
  X=x/d0, Y=y/d0, q=z/d0.
Then
  X^2+Y^2=q^2, gcd(X,Y)=1.


Let
  h=gcd(e,z),
  E=e/h, Z=z/h, H=R/h.
Then
  E^2+Z^2=H^2, gcd(E,Z)=1.


The two ordered primitive triples
  (X,Y,q) and (E,Z,H)
are uniquely determined by the physical point.


Retain229D: h=gcd(g,q) in the nested content notation and gcd(h,d0)=1.


3. Deterministic shared gcd t and exact elimination of the moving scales


Because the same z has two expressions,
  d0 q = h Z.                                    (229BD.1)


Since gcd(h,d0)=1, there is a unique positive integer t such that
  q=h t, Z=d0 t.                                 (229BD.2)


Moreover gcd(q,Z)=t*gcd(h,d0)=t, so
  t = gcd(q,Z),                                   (229BD.3)
  h = q/t,
  d0= Z/t.                                       (229BD.4)


Thus the previously moving scale h is NOT a freely chosen auxiliary modulus once the two primitive triples have been chosen. It is exactly the quotient of the inner primitive hypotenuse by its gcd with the outer primitive leg. The missing-face common scale d0 is the complementary quotient of that same gcd.


The relations do not assert gcd(h,t)=1 or gcd(d0,t)=1; these need not hold. The certified statement is gcd(h,d0)=1.


RESULT_229BD_EXACT_SHARED_GCD_AND_SCALE_ELIMINATION=PROVED_EXACT.


4. Exact positive reconstruction and inverse


Conversely take any two ordered primitive positive Pythagorean triples
  (X,Y,q): X^2+Y^2=q^2, gcd(X,Y)=1,
  (E,Z,H): E^2+Z^2=H^2, gcd(E,Z)=1.
Set
  t=gcd(q,Z),
  h=q/t,
  d0=Z/t.


Since gcd(h,d0)=1, reconstruct
  e=h E=(q/t)E,
  x=d0 X=(Z/t)X,
  y=d0 Y=(Z/t)Y,
  z=d0 q=h Z,
  R=h H=(q/t)H.                                  (229BD.5)


Both selector identities hold:
  x^2+y^2 = d0^2 q^2=z^2,
  e^2+z^2 = h^2 (E^2+Z^2)=h^2 H^2=R^2.


Primitivity:
  gcd(x,y)=d0.
Since h|q and gcd(q,X Y)=1, gcd(h,X Y)=1.
Since d0|Z and gcd(Z,E H)=1, gcd(d0,E H)=1.
Together with gcd(h,d0)=1, this gives
  gcd(e,d0)=gcd(hE,d0)=1,
hence gcd(e,x,y)=1.


The inverse extraction in section 2 recovers exactly the original two ordered primitive triples, because the reconstructed scales are the exact pairwise contents.


Thus (229BD.5) is a bijection between:
  (i) ordered pairs of positive primitive Pythagorean triples; and
  (ii) positive primitive physical quadruples satisfying the two square selectors,
with the exact cutoff on both sides
  R=(q H)/gcd(q,Z) <= B.                           (229BD.6)


Any further M3 masks are carried over by substitution in (229BD.5). There is no enlargement or unspecified fiber when those masks are retained.


RESULT_229BD_TWO_PRIMITIVE_TRIPLES_TO_TWO_SELECTOR_PHYSICAL_BIJECTION=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229BD_EXACT_PHYSICAL_HEIGHT=qH_OVER_GCD_qZ.


5. Primitive cross-gcd 2x2 incidence matrix


Because h is coprime to XY and d0 is coprime to EH, all four basic physical cross-gcds lose their external scales exactly:
  gcd(e,x)=gcd(E,X),
  gcd(e,y)=gcd(E,Y),
  gcd(R,x)=gcd(H,X),
  gcd(R,y)=gcd(H,Y).                              (229BD.7)


Define
  J_EX=gcd(E,X),
  J_EY=gcd(E,Y),
  J_HX=gcd(H,X),
  J_HY=gcd(H,Y).


These four positive integers are pairwise coprime:
  gcd(E,H)=1 in the outer primitive triple;
  gcd(X,Y)=1 in the inner primitive triple;
therefore a prime cannot appear in more than one of the four intersections.


The full odd edge-content and space-content buckets are
  A=O(J_EX J_EY),
  C=O(J_HX J_HY),                                 (229BD.8)
where O denotes odd part. The preexisting229AD/AS bucket labels may be identified with these products (up to the harmless X/Y label convention).


6. Exact quotient-free radical invariant


Retain229O:
  G_* = gcd(eR,xy).


Substitute (229BD.5):
  eR=h^2 E H,
  xy=d0^2 X Y.


By the coprimalities established above,
  gcd(h,d0 X Y)=1,
  gcd(d0,h E H)=1.
Consequently the positive integer gcd satisfies the exact equality
  G_* = gcd(E H, X Y).                             (229BD.9)


Since gcd(E,H)=gcd(X,Y)=1, it also factorizes as
  G_* = J_EX J_EY J_HX J_HY,                       (229BD.10)
with the four factors pairwise coprime.


Therefore
  (G_*)_odd=A C,
  K_* = sf(gcd(EH,XY)),                            (229BD.11)
with no h, d0 or t factor in the quotient-free radical receiver.


Furthermore:
  gcd(t,G_*)=1,
  gcd(h,G_*)=1,
  gcd(d0,G_*)=1,                                  (229BD.12)
because t,h divide the inner hypotenuse q, which is coprime to XY, while d0 divides the outer leg Z, which is coprime to EH.


RESULT_229BD_CROSS_GCD_MATRIX_AND_GSTAR_CROSSWALK=PROVED_EXACT.


7. Exact physical tail expressed on two primitive triples


For every fixed delta>0, the preferred Stage37 counting gate is exactly equivalent to
  # { ordered pairs ((X,Y,q),(E,Z,H)) of primitive positive Pythagorean triples:
       qH/gcd(q,Z) <= B;
       the further exact current Stage37 physical host/selector masks hold under (229BD.5);
       sf(gcd(EH,XY)) > B^(1/3-delta) }
    = o(B^(1/3)).                                  (229BD.13)


This equivalence has multiplicity ONE on ordered primitive-triple pairs and exactly preserves the original physical height and all retained masks. It is a theorem-facing support adapter, not a proof of the tail estimate.


The new perspective cleanly separates:
  radical receiver: gcd(EH,XY), independent of t;
  physical height: qH/t;
  glue: t=gcd(q,Z).


8. Primitive Euclid-pair router for the shared t


Write the inner primitive triple with coprime opposite-parity r>s:
  q=r^2+s^2,
  {X,Y}={2rs, r^2-s^2}.


Write the outer primitive triple with coprime opposite-parity m>n:
  H=m^2+n^2,
  {E,Z}={2mn, m^2-n^2},
with the chosen ordered placements retained.


Then
  t=gcd(r^2+s^2, Z(m,n)),                         (229BD.14)
  R=(r^2+s^2)(m^2+n^2)/t.                          (229BD.15)


Since t|q, all odd primes dividing t are 1 mod4, and t is odd. For each p^k||t,
  r^2+s^2 == 0 mod p^k,
with gcd(rs,p)=1, giving r==rho_p s mod p^k, rho_p^2==-1.


The same p^k divides the chosen outer leg Z:
- if Z=m^2-n^2, then m==+n or -n mod p^k (after a sign orientation);
- if Z=2mn, then the whole odd prime power lies in m or in n because gcd(m,n)=1.


These are exact necessary simultaneous congruence conditions, with at most subpower sign/allocation decorations in the physical B-height range. They are not independent sieve events and must NOT be multiplied as probabilities.


RESULT_229BD_SHARED_t_COUPLED_PRIMITIVE_EUCLID_RECEIVER=PROVED_EXACT.


9. Quantitative and Arsenal accounting


The 229BC fixed-(G,h) theorem remains valid and unchanged:
  N_{G,h}(B) << B^o(1)(1+B/(hG)).


229BD does not sum it, does not prove distributional decay for t, and does not eliminate the complexity of the moving support by itself.


What has changed is the exact source measure for future theorem matching:
the triple (G,h,(m,n)) can be replaced, without multiplicity loss, by a pair of primitive Euclid packets linked by t=gcd(q,Z), provided every current physical mask is carried forward.


Promising next theorem inputs:
(A) a same-measure count of primitive Euclid-parameter pairs with the joint t congruence, exact product height (229BD.15), and large sf(gcd(EH,XY));
(B) an exact divisor switch using t|q and t|Z, with gcd(t,G_*)=1, which does not recharge the already consumed raw G-modulus of229BC;
(C) a quantitative decomposition into t-large / t-small (equivalently h-small / h-large) sectors with a certified global weighted support bound;
(D) use the four coprime primitive cross-gcd components in (229BD.10) to match an existing Arsenal large-content theorem at the exact pair-of-triples measure.


AR-009 / S36-PW07 are retained only as structural routers on the shared physical support, not independent density gains.
229BB uniform Pell root completion remains charged once if used, never alongside an incompatible re-count of the same physical fibers.


10. State and firewalls


No existence or nonexistence conclusion for a perfect cuboid is claimed.
No global population exponent improvement is claimed.
Do not drop the additional M3 host/selector masks when passing to all primitive-triple pairs.
Do not sum over t as if t were an independent free variable; it is the exact gcd(q,Z).
Do not assume gcd(h,t)=1.
Do not multiply the 229BC raw-G outer root-line density with the new t-lines without a joint same-measure theorem.
Do not turn a bijection into a density saving.
Do not reopen PAIR/LOCAL/A/FIB/TQ/CM/collision or other closed routes absent their explicit restart hypotheses.


POST_229_REOPEN_TRIGGER_FOUND=EXACT_DOUBLE_PRIMITIVE_PAIR_THEOREM_INTERFACE_ONLY.
M3_T11_230=NOT_ISSUED.
GLOBAL_OPERATION=HOLD_PENDING_SELECTOR_AWARE_OR_SUPPORT_LEVEL_THEOREM_INPUT.
PRIMARY_GATE=M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN.
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0.
P_OVER_M3_LIMIT_PROVED=false.
INTEGRATED_AUDIT_186_229O_SCOPE_UNCHANGED=true.


11. Writeback and next chat


This card is a new exact post-229 structural adapter. It supersedes neither the existing authority nor the 229BC fixed-(G,h) counting result.


Current next operation:
  investigate the t-divisor switch and a joint (G,t) theorem on exact two-primitive-triple pair measure under R=qH/t<=B, including all physical masks.


Existing authority/credit/gate/closure/HOLD flags are unchanged.
NEXT_NEW_CHAT_CAN_RESUME_FROM_DRIVE_ONLY=true.

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229BC — outer primitive Pythagorean modulus-G router and fixed-(G,h) support count


STATUS: POST_229BB_OUTER_EUCLID_ROUTER_COMPLETE / PROVED_PRIMITIVE_OUTER_EUCLID_PARAMETERIZATION / PROVED_SPLIT_HYPOTENUSE_CONTENT_C_GIVES_FULL_RAW_C_ROOT_LINE / PROVED_EDGE_CONTENT_A_GIVES_COMPLEMENTARY_RAW_A_ROUTER_IN_BOTH_PARITY_CASES / PROVED_COMBINED_OUTER_MODULUS_G / PROVED_FIXED_G_h_OUTER_SUPPORT_COUNT_1_PLUS_B_OVER_hG / PELL_COMPLETION_COMPOSED_ONCE / MOVING_h_SCALE_REMAINS_BLOCKER / NO_COUNTING_PROMOTION / GLOBAL_GATE_UNCHANGED / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_GLOBAL_REOPEN


TYPE: POST-229BB ROOT-FREE OUTER SUPPORT / PRIMITIVE PYTHAGOREAN EUCLID ROUTER / RAW-CONTENT CRT ROOT LINE / AR-009 REENTRY / FIXED-(G,h) SAME-MEASURE COUNT / SCALE-SUM FIREWALL


OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY: M3-T11-229
LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION: M3-T11-228
PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA: Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229BB
PRIMARY_GATE: M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN
M3_T11_230: NOT ISSUED
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT: 0
CARD_DOC_ID: 1te0VBREA_Uw-fWdbo_HXzdpTiw8UTBrSl0o1n7blnu4


1. Scope


229BB removed all central root coordinates from the fixed-power outer support by proving B^o(1) completion for fixed normalized endpoint quotient.


The remaining root-free physical receiver contains
  A := A_-A_+,
  C := C_-C_+,
  G := AC=(G_*)_odd,
  h,
  E0,
  R0,
with
  e/h=A E0,
  R/h=C R0,
and
  (A E0)^2 + Z0^2 = (C R0)^2,                    (229BC.1)
where
  Z0=z/h.


Retain229BB:
  gcd(AE0,CR0)=1,                                 (229BC.2)
so (229BC.1) is a primitive Pythagorean triple.


Retain229AD/AS:
- A,C are odd and coprime;
- every prime of C is 1 mod4;
- A may contain primes 1 or3 mod4;
- h is odd, split-prime-only and coprime to G.


This card parameterizes (229BC.1) and pushes the exact A/C divisibility into the primitive Euclid parameters.


2. Primitive Euclid parameterization


There exist unique positive coprime integers
  m>n,
  gcd(m,n)=1,
  m not congruent n mod2,
such that
  C R0 = m^2+n^2,                                 (229BC.3)
and exactly one of the following two cases holds.


EDGE-EVEN:
  A E0 = 2mn,
  Z0   = m^2-n^2.                                 (229BC.4)


EDGE-ODD:
  A E0 = m^2-n^2,
  Z0   = 2mn.                                     (229BC.5)


The finite interchange of the two primitive legs is exactly this two-case router.


Since
  R=h C R0=h(m^2+n^2),
the physical cutoff is
  h(m^2+n^2)<=B.                                  (229BC.6)


RESULT_229BC_PRIMITIVE_OUTER_EUCLID_PARAMETERIZATION=PROVED_EXACT.


3. Full raw C is a modular square-root line


From (229BC.3),
  C | m^2+n^2.                                    (229BC.7)


Because gcd(m,n)=1, every prime p|C is coprime to mn.
Because every p|C is 1 mod4, for each prime power p^k||C the congruence
  t^2 == -1 mod p^k
has exactly two solutions.


Therefore, after charging at most
  2^omega(C)=B^o(1)
orientations, there is a fixed unit rho_C modulo C such that
  m == rho_C n mod C,
  rho_C^2 == -1 mod C.                            (229BC.8)


RESULT_229BC_FULL_RAW_C_HYPOTENUSE_ROOT_LINE=PROVED_EXACT.


This uses the complete raw powers in C, not only sf(C).


4. EDGE-ODD: A supplies the complementary root-of-one line


Assume
  A E0=m^2-n^2.


Then
  A | (m-n)(m+n).                                 (229BC.9)


Because gcd(m,n)=1 and m,n have opposite parity,
  gcd(m-n,m+n)=1
for odd prime support.


Thus for each odd prime power p^k||A, the whole p^k lies in exactly one of
  m-n,
  m+n.


After at most
  2^omega(A)=B^o(1)
orientation choices,
  m == rho_A n mod A,
  rho_A^2 == 1 mod A.                             (229BC.10)


Since gcd(A,C)=1, (229BC.8) and (229BC.10) combine by CRT into one line
  m == rho_G n mod G=AC,                          (229BC.11)
with the prescribed root-of-one behavior on A and root-of-minus-one behavior on C.


RESULT_229BC_EDGE_ODD_COMBINED_MODULUS_G_ROOT_LINE=PROVED_EXACT.


5. EDGE-EVEN: A is charged as coordinate divisibility and still yields modulus G density


Assume
  A E0=2mn.


Because A is odd,
  A | mn.                                         (229BC.12)


Since gcd(m,n)=1, every prime power of A occurs wholly in exactly one of m,n.
Thus after at most
  2^omega(A)=B^o(1)
allocations there is a factorization
  A=A_m A_n,
  gcd(A_m,A_n)=1,
with
  A_m|m,
  A_n|n.                                          (229BC.13)


Write
  m=A_m r,
  n=A_n s.
Then gcd(r,s)=1.


The C-line (229BC.8) becomes
  A_m r == rho_C A_n s mod C.                    (229BC.14)


Since gcd(A,C)=1, A_m and A_n are units modulo C. Therefore (r,s) lie on one fixed line modulo C.


For dyadic boxes
  m~M,
  n~N,
the scaled variables have side lengths
  M/A_m,
  N/A_n.
The ordinary root-line lattice count gives
  # {(r,s)}
   << 1 + MN/(A_m A_n C)
   = 1 + MN/G.                                    (229BC.15)


RESULT_229BC_EDGE_EVEN_COORDINATE_SPLIT_PLUS_C_LINE=PROVED_EXACT.


Thus the even-leg branch loses the same full raw factor G from the two-dimensional Euclid-parameter area, although A acts by coordinate divisibility rather than by a root-of-one slope.


6. Unified fixed-(atoms,h) outer parameter count


In EDGE-ODD, (229BC.11) gives for each charged orientation
  # {(m,n) in a dyadic MxN box}
   << 1+MN/G.                                     (229BC.16)


In EDGE-EVEN, (229BC.15) gives the identical bound.


The physical cutoff (229BC.6) implies
  MN <= (m^2+n^2)/2 <= B/(2h).                    (229BC.17)


There are only B^o(1) parity, orientation/allocation and dyadic decorations.


Therefore, for fixed
  A_-,A_+,C_-,C_+,h,
the number of outer primitive Euclid pairs is
  << B^o(1)(1+B/(hG)).                            (229BC.18)


RESULT_229BC_FIXED_ATOMS_h_OUTER_PAIR_COUNT=PROVED_EXACT.


7. Compose with229BB Pell completion


Each primitive Euclid pair (m,n) determines
  E0
from (229BC.4) or (229BC.5), and
  R0=(m^2+n^2)/C.                                 (229BC.19)


229BB proves that fixed atom,h,E0 data have only B^o(1) complete central-root fibers, and then only finite physical endpoint reconstruction.


Therefore the positive primitive physical endpoint population with fixed atoms and h satisfies
  N_{atoms,h}(B)
   << B^o(1)(1+B/(hG)).                            (229BC.20)


For fixed raw G and h, the number of pairwise-coprime ordered atom allocations
  G=A_-A_+C_-C_+
is at most
  4^omega(G)=G^o(1).


Hence
  N_{G,h}(B)
   << B^o(1)(1+B/(hG)).                            (229BC.21)


RESULT_229BC_FIXED_G_h_SAME_PHYSICAL_COUNT=PROVED_SCOPED.


This improves the fixed-(G,h) theorem interface from229BA/BB by using the exact primitive outer Pythagorean geometry after root completion has been compressed.


8. Why the modulus G is structurally natural


The two raw content halves have complementary Euclid roles:


  C=C_-C_+:
    divides the primitive hypotenuse m^2+n^2,
    so every prime gives a root of -1;


  A=A_-A_+:
    divides the selected primitive leg.
    In EDGE-ODD it gives roots of +1.
    In EDGE-EVEN its prime powers split between the two coprime coordinates.


Thus both parity cases consume the entire raw product
  G=AC
once and only once.


This is not a multiplication of independent densities:
- in EDGE-ODD it is one CRT line modulo G;
- in EDGE-EVEN it is one coordinate-divisibility charge of total size A followed by one C-line.


RESULT_229BC_FULL_RAW_G_OUTER_EUCLID_ROUTER=PROVED_EXACT.


9. Quantitative meaning at the preferred radical threshold


The preferred gate concerns
  sf(G_*)>B^(1/3-delta).


The odd raw content satisfies
  G=(G_*)_odd >= sf_odd(G_*).


Thus, up to the fixed prime2 issue, the large-radical sector has
  G >> B^(1/3-delta).                             (229BC.22)


For each fixed (G,h), the nonconstant term in (229BC.21) is at most
  B^(2/3+delta+o(1))/h.                            (229BC.23)


This is a genuine fixed-(G,h) improvement, but it is not close enough by itself to the required global o(B^(1/3)) tail and cannot be summed over moving G,h without further information.


RESULT_229BC_FIXED_G_h_COUNTING_CREDIT=0.


10. The moving h-scale is now isolated as a distinct blocker


The outer primitive pair uses the height
  R=h(m^2+n^2).                                   (229BC.24)


For fixed h the full raw G gives the correct root-line/divisibility saving.


However summing (229BC.21) naively over all h is illegal/too weak:
the boundary term 1 per h is uncontrolled, and h is a self-generated physical scale, not an independent random modulus.


Retain
  h=gcd(e,R)=gcd(g,q)
from229AD and
  gcd(h,G)=1.


Therefore the next missing theorem can be stated sharply as a scale-support problem rather than a root-completion problem:


  count realized triples
    (G,h,(m,n))
  with
    h(m^2+n^2)<=B,
    the full modulus-G outer router,
    h=gcd(e,R) arising from the nested physical system,
    and the229AY/BA local-character filters,
  with enough saving after summing h and G.


CURRENT_BLOCKER=MOVING_BASE_HILBERT_SCALE_h_ON_MODULUS_G_PRIMITIVE_EUCLID_SUPPORT.


11. Arsenal consequence


AR-009:
  now has a cleaner outer application than the central-root application:
  after229BB root completion compression, the entire C hypotenuse content produces a raw modulus-C root line on primitive Euclid parameters, and EDGE-ODD combines it with A to modulus G.


AR-010:
  remains consumed correctly by229BB. Root completions are subpower after fixing the outer quotient; do not recount them.


SR-STR-090:
  Pell completion is charged exactly once through229BB.


S36-PW07:
 229AY atom rows and229BA h rows remain admissibility filters on the same outer support.


AR-023/024 measure firewall:
  the outer pair count is on the exact primitive physical outer triple with R=h(m^2+n^2)<=B; no ambient unrestricted slope density is multiplied into an endpoint count.


12. Next research inputs


Priority A:
  exploit h=gcd(g,q) inside the nested229AD factorization to count the moving h-scale on the exact outer Euclid support.


Priority B:
  derive a second modulus or complementary divisor switch involving h without recharging the already-consumed G root line.


Priority C:
  combine the split-only h support with the h-character rows of229BA and the modulus-G outer router in one same-measure sieve.


Priority D:
  seek an external theorem only after S37-WF02 confirms it controls the weighted sum over h and G, not merely fixed moduli.


Priority E:
  retain229AR W_-=UV-eR as the parallel full-threshold receiver.


13. Firewalls and unchanged state


Do not:
- sum the fixed-(G,h) bound over h as if h had bounded support;
- multiply the EDGE-ODD A and C conditions as probabilities; they are one CRT line mod G;
- charge A twice in EDGE-EVEN after scaling m,n;
- recharge229BB Pell completion;

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229BB — uniform Pell completion compression and root-free outer support


STATUS: POST_229BA_AR010_PELL_RECONSTRUCTION_COMPLETE / REPROVED_UNIFORM_BINARY_NORM_COUNT / PROVED_FIXED_E0_ROOT_COMPLETION_B_O1 / PROVED_FIXED_R0_ROOT_COMPLETION_B_O1 / PROVED_ROOT_FREE_OUTER_SUPPORT_PUSHFORWARD / PROVED_PRIMITIVE_OUTER_PYTHAGOREAN_RECEIVER / ROOT_COMPLETION_NO_LONGER_FIXED_POWER_BLOCKER / OUTER_SUPPORT_COUNT_OPEN / NO_COUNTING_PROMOTION / GLOBAL_GATE_UNCHANGED / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_GLOBAL_REOPEN


TYPE: POST-229BA ARSENAL REUSE / UNIFORM PELL-NORM COMPLETION / AR-010 ONE-PAIR RECONSTRUCTION / ROOT-FREE SUPPORT COMPRESSION / PRIMITIVE OUTER PYTHAGOREAN RECEIVER / METHOD FIREWALL


OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY: M3-T11-229
LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION: M3-T11-228
PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA: Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229BA
PRIMARY_GATE: M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN
M3_T11_230: NOT ISSUED
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT: 0
CARD_DOC_ID: 1NFrTZpl6cw3UWBJJDhZAD1Y6KjY-OrHK1FlAfJAUDpE


1. Scope and Arsenal trigger


229BA sharpened the current receiver to the combined index-Gh^3 root lattice plus the exact normalized endpoint quotient rectangle.


The requested Arsenal reassessment exposes a direct reusable counting lemma:
Stage27-19-r5am / StructureRadar SR-STR-090 proved a uniform Pell/norm completion bound.


Because that source is not current Stage37 authority, this card reproves the abstract lemma before using it. No Stage19 population or exponent is imported.


Retain229BA notation:
  A := A_-A_+,
  C := C_-C_+,
  G := AC = (G_*)_odd,
and positive integers
  E0=e/(hA),
  R0=R/(hC),
with
  gcd(E0,R0)=1.


Retain the exact quotient rectangle:
  eta2 C_+ x2^2 - eta0 C_- x0^2
    = 2h A_+ E0,                                  (229BB.1)


  eta1 C_+ x1^2 - eta3 C_- x3^2
    = 2h A_- E0,                                  (229BB.2)


  eta3 A_+ x3^2 - eta0 A_- x0^2
    = 2h C_+ R0,                                  (229BB.3)


  eta1 A_+ x1^2 - eta2 A_- x2^2
    = 2h C_- R0.                                  (229BB.4)


All coefficients and roots have polynomial height in B.


2. Uniform binary norm/Pell count


Lemma 229BB-Pell.
Let positive integers P,Q,N,H be given. The number of positive integer solutions
  P X^2 - Q Y^2 = N,
  X,Y <= H
is
  <<_epsilon (PQNH)^epsilon
uniformly in P,Q,N,H.


Proof.


Multiply by P:
  (PX)^2 - PQ Y^2 = PN.                            (229BB.5)


Put D=PQ and M=PN.


If D=t^2 is a square, then
  (PX-tY)(PX+tY)=M.
Thus the number of positive solutions is at most the number of divisor pairs of M, hence M^o(1).


If D is not a square, write
  D=t^2 d
with d>1 squarefree and work in the maximal order O_K of K=Q(sqrt d).


Every positive solution gives
  alpha=PX+tY sqrt d in O_K,
with
  Norm(alpha)=M
and both real embeddings positive.


Then the principal ideal (alpha) is an integral ideal divisor of (M).
For p^v||M, the number of local ideal-divisor exponent choices is O((2v+1)^2), uniformly in the splitting type. Hence the total number of possible integral ideals (alpha) is
  <= tau(M^2)^2=M^o(1).                            (229BB.6)


For a fixed principal ideal, all totally positive generators of norm M differ by powers of a totally positive norm-one unit.
A nontrivial totally positive norm-one unit has integer trace at least3, hence is at least
  (3+sqrt5)/2>1.
Inside the polynomial height box there are therefore only
  O(log(PQNH))
unit translates.


Multiplying with (229BB.6) proves the lemma.


RESULT_229BB_UNIFORM_BINARY_NORM_COUNT=PROVED_EXACT.


This is the same abstract mechanism harvested as SR-STR-090, but its proof is included here so Stage37 does not depend on the source-stage population contract.


3. Fixed E0 gives B^o(1) complete central-root fibers


Fix
  A_-,A_+,C_-,C_+,h,
  eta0,eta1,eta2,eta3,
  E0.


Equation (229BB.1) is a positive binary norm equation in (x2,x0):
  P=eta2 C_+,
  Q=eta0 C_-,
  N=2hA_+E0.


The uniform lemma gives
  # {(x0,x2) satisfying (229BB.1)}
    =B^o(1).                                      (229BB.7)


Independently, (229BB.2) is a positive binary norm equation in (x1,x3):
  P=eta1 C_+,
  Q=eta3 C_-,
  N=2hA_-E0,
so
  # {(x1,x3) satisfying (229BB.2)}
    =B^o(1).                                      (229BB.8)


The product of two subpower quantities is still B^o(1).
Equations (229BB.3)-(229BB.4), the combined Gh^3 lattice congruences, positivity, primitivity and exact physical cutoff are postfilters.


Therefore
  # {central root quadruples above fixed atom,h,eta,E0 data}
   =B^o(1).                                       (229BB.9)


RESULT_229BB_FIXED_E0_CENTRAL_ROOT_COMPLETION=B_O1_PROVED_EXACT.


This is a genuine AR-010-style reconstruction/completion compression:
once the normalized edge quotient E0 is fixed, no root coordinate carries fixed-power multiplicity.


4. Fixed R0 gives the symmetric B^o(1) fiber


Fix the same coefficient data and R0.


Equations (229BB.3)-(229BB.4) are two positive binary norm equations:
- one in (x3,x0);
- one in (x1,x2).


Applying the same lemma twice gives
  # {central root quadruples above fixed atom,h,eta,R0 data}
   =B^o(1).                                       (229BB.10)


RESULT_229BB_FIXED_R0_CENTRAL_ROOT_COMPLETION=B_O1_PROVED_EXACT.


Thus either normalized endpoint quotient may be used as the outer coordinate.


5. Root-free support pushforward


Define the realized E-support
  E_B :=
  { (A_-,A_+,C_-,C_+,h,E0)
    arising from positive primitive physical endpoints R<=B }.      (229BB.11)


The eta bits have only 16 possibilities, and by (229BB.9) each fixed tuple in E_B has only B^o(1) central-root completions. Each completed central-root tuple reconstructs at most finitely many physical endpoints by229AY.


Therefore
  P(B) <= B^o(1) #E_B.                             (229BB.12)


Similarly define
  R_B :=
  { (A_-,A_+,C_-,C_+,h,R0)
    arising physically }.
Then
  P(B) <= B^o(1) #R_B.                             (229BB.13)


RESULT_229BB_ROOT_FREE_OUTER_SUPPORT_PUSHFORWARD=PROVED_EXACT.


This strictly changes the theorem-matching interface:
the roots x0,x1,x2,x3 are no longer part of the fixed-power outer support once E0 or R0 is fixed.


6. Elementary fixed coefficient-h bound


The physical inequalities give
  e=h A E0 < B,
  R=h C R0 <= B.


Hence
  E0 <= B/(hA),
  R0 <= B/(hC).                                   (229BB.14)


For fixed atoms and h, summing the B^o(1) completion bound over either outer quotient yields
  N_{atoms,h}(B)
   << B^o(1)
      min(
        1+B/(hA),
        1+B/(hC)
      )                                           (229BB.15)
   << B^o(1)
      (1+B/(h max(A,C))).


Since AC=G,
  max(A,C)>=sqrt(G),
so coarsely
  N_{atoms,h}(B)
   << B^o(1)(1+B/(h sqrt(G))).                    (229BB.16)


RESULT_229BB_FIXED_ATOMS_h_ROOT_FREE_BOUND=PROVED_SCOPED.


This is not by itself stronger than229BA in every atom regime; its main value is removal of the root coordinates from the outer support.


7. Primitive outer Pythagorean receiver


Retain h as the content of
  e^2+z^2=R^2.


Set
  Z0:=z/h.
Using e/h=A E0 and R/h=C R0 gives
  (A E0)^2 + Z0^2 = (C R0)^2.                    (229BB.17)


Because h is the exact content,
  gcd(AE0,Z0,CR0)=1,
and in particular
  gcd(AE0,CR0)=1.                                 (229BB.18)


Therefore the following stronger coprimalities hold:
  gcd(A,C)=1,
  gcd(E0,R0)=1,
  gcd(A,R0)=1,
  gcd(C,E0)=1.                                    (229BB.19)


RESULT_229BB_PRIMITIVE_OUTER_PYTHAGOREAN_RECEIVER=PROVED_EXACT.


The root-free support is thus not an arbitrary six-variable box. Its compressed outer coordinates satisfy one primitive Pythagorean relation in which:
- A=A_-A_+ is the edge-content side and may carry inert odd primes;
- C=C_-C_+ is split-prime-only;
- h is a separate split-prime-only common content;
- E0,R0 are cross-coprime to the opposite content products.


8. Relation to229BA lattice counting


229BA showed:
  [Z^4:L_{rho,sigma}]=Gh^3
and obtained a one-free-root lattice bound.


229BB shows a different, complementary fact:
after one normalized quotient E0 or R0 is fixed, the remaining full root completion is already B^o(1) by binary norm theory.


Thus the current hierarchy is:


  coefficient/content support
    (A_-,A_+,C_-,C_+,h,E0)
       |
       | uniform Pell completion B^o(1)
       v
  central roots
       |
       | finite229AY reconstruction
       v
  physical endpoint.


The Gh^3 lattice remains valuable for counting the moving outer support or for gaining additional savings before E0/R0 is fixed, but it is no longer necessary to bound a fixed outer completion fiber.


9. Quantitative firewall


The new compression does not count #E_B or #R_B.


A naive count of possible E0 values produces B/(hA), and a naive count of R0 produces B/(hC). Those supports are still too large in the worst balanced regime.


Likewise the uniform Pell lemma is a completion theorem, not a zero-density theorem for moving coefficients.


Therefore:
- do not charge the Pell B^o(1) completion as an independent density saving on top of229BA;
- do not multiply the two Pell equation counts as two fixed-power savings;
- do not replace the realized support E_B by all integer coefficient tuples;
- do not infer a global one-third tail bound from fixed-E0 rigidity.


RESULT_229BB_PELL_COMPLETION_COUNTING_CREDIT=0.


10. Arsenal consequence


AR-010:
  now genuinely activated as a reconstruction principle. A normalized endpoint quotient is a smaller outer coordinate than the generic moving quadric/root packet, and fixed outer quotient has B^o(1) completion.


SR-STR-090 / Stage27-19-r5am:
  abstract uniform Pell-count lemma is directly applicable after independent reproving in this card. No Stage19 population/exponent is imported.

  still not needed for completion, and its exact reciprocal difference-of-squares signature is not asserted.

  retained for support counting before fixing E0/R0 and for possible high-core/root-line savings.


S36-PW07:

S35-PW04:

11. Current blocker after229BB


The fixed root-completion problem is no longer the main blocker.


The preferred counting object is now the realized root-free support
  E_B or R_B,
with the exact primitive outer Pythagorean structure (229BB.17)-(229BB.19), atom pairwise coprimality, h split-only support, C split-only support,229AY/BA character filters and physical R<=B.


CURRENT_BLOCKER=

WITH_PRIMITIVE_OUTER_PYTHAGOREAN_REALIZATION.


Highest-value next operations:
(A) parameterize the primitive outer Pythagorean triple (AE0,Z0,CR0) and push the atom/h divisibility into its coprime Euclid parameters;
(B) test whether C split-only plus h split-only and the229AY/BA character rows produce a genuine growing-modulus sieve on that exact outer support;
(C) combine the Gh^3 lattice with the outer Pythagorean parameterization without charging either mechanism twice;
(D) seek a same-measure theorem directly counting E_B or R_B at the one-third budget.

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229BA — base-Hilbert h-core root synchronization and Gh^3 joint lattice compression


STATUS: POST_229AZ_BASE_HILBERT_CORE_REINSERTION_COMPLETE / PROVED_h_COPRIME_TO_RAW_G / PROVED_FOUR_CENTRAL_ROOTS_SYNCHRONIZE_MOD_h / PROVED_EXACT_h3_ROOT_LATTICE / PROVED_COMBINED_Gh3_LATTICE_INDEX / PROVED_ONE_FREE_ROOT_JOINT_COUNT / PROVED_NORMALIZED_ENDPOINT_QUOTIENT_RECTANGLE / PROVED_ETA_TOTAL_PARITY_EVEN / GENERIC_QUADRIC_ONLY_ROUTE_REFINED / NO_COUNTING_PROMOTION / GLOBAL_GATE_UNCHANGED / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_GLOBAL_REOPEN


TYPE: POST-229AZ BASE-HILBERT h-CORE REINSERTION / CENTRAL ROOT SYNCHRONIZATION / COPRIME LATTICE PRODUCT / ONE-FREE-ROOT COUNT / NORMALIZED ENDPOINT QUOTIENT RECEIVER / METHOD FIREWALL


OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY: M3-T11-229
LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION: M3-T11-228
PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA: Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AZ
PRIMARY_GATE: M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN
M3_T11_230: NOT ISSUED
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT: 0
CARD_DOC_ID: 15jrSbEpdYJj8rzo9clZnXM7WCitZzUhPathKwBjrGik


1. Scope


229AZ isolated the current blocker as the exact index-G atom root lattice intersected with the moving diagonal quadric.


The Arsenal/route review now reinserts a physical content bucket that was absent from the 229AY/AZ support: the base-Hilbert bucket h from229AD.


Retain229AD:
  h = gcd(e,z),
and the Pythagorean triple
  e^2+z^2=R^2
has content h. Hence
  h=gcd(e,R).                                      (229BA.1)


Retain also that:
- h is odd;
- every odd prime of h is 1 mod4;
- h is coprime to the physical buckets a,b,c12,c21 of229AD.


Retain229AS:
  G := (G_*)_odd
     = A_-A_+C_-C_+,
with the four atoms pairwise coprime and
  A_-A_+=(ab)_odd,
  C_-C_+=(c12 c21)_odd.


Therefore
  gcd(h,G)=1.                                      (229BA.2)


RESULT_229BA_BASE_HILBERT_h_COPRIME_TO_RAW_GODD=PROVED_EXACT.


2. Retained central root normal form


Use229AY notation
  lambda = eta0 A_-C_- x0^2,
  S      = eta1 A_+C_+ x1^2,
  L_-    = eta2 A_-C_+ x2^2,
  L_+    = eta3 A_+C_- x3^2,                     (229BA.3)
where eta_j in {1,2} and xj>0.


The additive rectangle is
  L_- - lambda = 2e,
  S - L_+      = 2e,
  L_+ - lambda = 2R,
  S - L_-      = 2R.                              (229BA.4)


Because h|e and h|R,
  lambda == S == L_- == L_+ mod h.                (229BA.5)


3. The common residue is a unit modulo h


Let p be an odd prime dividing h.


If p divided lambda, then p divides eR and lambda, so
  p | gcd_odd(eR,lambda)=Q_-=A_-C_-.
Thus p|G, contradicting (229BA.2).


The same argument with S,L_-,L_+ and their exact229AS Q/P packets gives
  gcd(h,lambda S L_-L_+)=1.                       (229BA.6)


Hence every xj and every atom coefficient appearing in (229BA.3) is a unit modulo h.


RESULT_229BA_CENTRAL_COMMON_h_RESIDUE_IS_UNIT=PROVED_EXACT.


4. Four-root synchronization modulo h


From (229BA.3)-(229BA.5),
  eta0 A_-C_- x0^2
   == eta1 A_+C_+ x1^2
   == eta2 A_-C_+ x2^2
   == eta3 A_+C_- x3^2       mod h.               (229BA.7)


Fix one physical point and use x0 as anchor.


For each prime power p^k||h, each of the three unit ratios
  x1/x0, x2/x0, x3/x0
is a square root of a fixed unit modulo p^k. Since p is odd, a unit square has exactly two square roots modulo p^k.


Thus after charging at most
  2^(3 omega(h))=B^o(1)
orientation triples, there exist fixed units sigma1,sigma2,sigma3 modulo h with
  x1 == sigma1 x0 mod h,
  x2 == sigma2 x0 mod h,
  x3 == sigma3 x0 mod h.                          (229BA.8)


RESULT_229BA_BASE_h_THREE_ROOT_LINES=PROVED_EXACT.


This is not a new independent probability. It is one common physical h-core relation.


5. Exact h^3 lattice index


For fixed h-orientation sigma define
  L_h subset Z^4
by (229BA.8).


The homomorphism
  Psi_h: Z^4 -> (Z/hZ)^3,
  Psi_h(x0,x1,x2,x3)
    =(x1-sigma1 x0,
      x2-sigma2 x0,
      x3-sigma3 x0)
is surjective: set x0=0 and choose x1,x2,x3 arbitrarily modulo h.


Therefore
  [Z^4:L_h]=h^3.                                  (229BA.9)


RESULT_229BA_h_ROOT_LATTICE_INDEX=h3_PROVED_EXACT.


6. Combine with the229AZ atom lattice


Retain229AZ:
for fixed atom orientations rho, the four atom root lines define
  L_rho subset Z^4
with
  [Z^4:L_rho]=G.                                  (229BA.10)


By (229BA.2),
  gcd(G,h^3)=1.


For finite-index subgroups of Z^4 with coprime indices,
  [Z^4:L_rho intersect L_h]
   =[Z^4:L_rho][Z^4:L_h].


Hence the exact combined physical root lattice
  L_{rho,sigma}:=L_rho intersect L_h
satisfies
  [Z^4:L_{rho,sigma}]
   =G h^3.                                        (229BA.11)


RESULT_229BA_COMBINED_ATOM_BASEHILBERT_ROOT_LATTICE_INDEX=G_TIMES_h3_PROVED_EXACT.


This is a genuine strengthening of229AZ: the base Hilbert bucket supplies three additional mutually coprime root-line moduli.


7. Same-measure one-free-root count


Let xj lie in positive dyadic intervals of lengths/scales Xj.


Use x0 as the free anchor.


The combined h and atom congruences force:
- x2 into one residue class modulo h A_+;
- x3 into one residue class modulo h C_+;
- once x2,x3 are fixed, x1 into one residue class modulo
    h A_-C_- = h Q_-.


Therefore
  N_{rho,sigma}(X)
   << X0
      (1+X2/(h A_+))
      (1+X3/(h C_+))
      (1+X1/(h Q_-)).                             (229BA.12)


There are three symmetric anchor versions obtained by choosing x1,x2,x3 as the free coordinate.


Retain229AZ root-height constraints:
  Q_- X0^2 << B,
  Q_+ X1^2 << B,
  P_- X2^2 << B,
  P_+ X3^2 << B,                                  (229BA.13)
and
  X0X1X2X3 << B^2/G.                              (229BA.14)


Choose the smallest root scale as the anchor. Then
  min_j Xj
   <= (X0X1X2X3)^(1/4)
   << B^(1/2) G^(-1/4).                           (229BA.15)


Expanding the corresponding anchor count and using (229BA.13) gives the symmetric coarse bound
  N_{rho,sigma}(X)
   << B^(1/2)G^(-1/4)
      + B/(h sqrt(G))
      + B^(3/2)/(h^2 G)
      + B^2/(h^3 G^2).                            (229BA.16)


RESULT_229BA_COMBINED_LATTICE_ONE_FREE_ROOT_BOUND=PROVED_EXACT_UP_TO_ABSOLUTE_DYADIC_CONSTANTS.


The key structural change from229AZ is the leading support dimension:
-229AZ lattice-only count left two roots free;
-229BA combined G-h lattice leaves only one root free.


8. Fixed (G,h) physical endpoint consequence


Fix raw odd G and the base bucket h.


The number of pairwise-coprime atom allocations
  G=A_-A_+C_-C_+
is at most 4^omega(G)=G^o(1).


The atom and h root-orientation choices, eta bits and dyadic boxes together cost B^o(1).


Retain229AY that the seven-coordinate central-root support has physical fiber <=16.


Therefore the positive primitive physical endpoints with fixed (G,h) satisfy the scoped bound
  N_{G,h}(B)
   << B^o(1) [
        B^(1/2)G^(-1/4)
        + B/(h sqrt(G))
        + B^(3/2)/(h^2 G)
        + B^2/(h^3 G^2)
      ].                                          (229BA.17)


RESULT_229BA_FIXED_G_h_SAME_PHYSICAL_COUNT=PROVED_SCOPED.


No summation over moving G or h is asserted.


9. New base-h character rows


Write eta_j=2^eps_j.


For every odd p|h, (229BA.7) and the fact that all roots are units imply
  (eta0 A_-C_-/p)
  =(eta1 A_+C_+/p)
  =(eta2 A_-C_+/p)
  =(eta3 A_+C_-/p).                               (229BA.18)


Equivalently,
  (C_-C_+/p)
   =(2/p)^(eps0+eps2)
   =(2/p)^(eps1+eps3),                            (229BA.19)


and
  (A_-A_+/p)
   =(2/p)^(eps0+eps3)
   =(2/p)^(eps1+eps2).                            (229BA.20)


These are base-Hilbert h rows, not atom-support rows. They are retained as same-support necessary conditions only.


RESULT_229BA_BASE_h_CHARACTER_ROWS=PROVED_EXACT.


10. Exact normalized endpoint quotient rectangle


The h-core also exposes a smaller exact physical receiver.


Define
  E0 := e /(h A_-A_+),
  R0 := R /(h C_-C_+).                            (229BA.21)


These are positive integers because h is coprime to the current atom products and the atom products divide the corresponding physical contents.


Since h is the content of the Pythagorean triple (e,z,R),
  gcd(e/h,R/h)=1.
Hence
  gcd(E0,R0)=1.                                   (229BA.22)


Divide the four exact differences (229BA.4) by their common atom edge. One obtains
  eta2 C_+ x2^2 - eta0 C_- x0^2
    = 2h A_+ E0,                                  (229BA.23)


  eta1 C_+ x1^2 - eta3 C_- x3^2
    = 2h A_- E0,                                  (229BA.24)


  eta3 A_+ x3^2 - eta0 A_- x0^2
    = 2h C_+ R0,                                  (229BA.25)


  eta1 A_+ x1^2 - eta2 A_- x2^2
    = 2h C_- R0.                                  (229BA.26)

Thus the moving diagonal quadric of229AZ is not the whole minimal receiver: the same physical roots simultaneously satisfy two exact E0 equations and two exact R0 equations with coprime normalized endpoint quotients.


Reducing (229BA.23)-(229BA.26) modulo h recovers the h-root synchronization, but the quotient identities retain strictly more information.


11. Total eta parity and primitive split-quadric firewall


Retain229AV:
  lambda S L_- L_+ = 4 x^2 y^2
for the original physical edge variables x,y.


Insert (229BA.3) and
  Q_-Q_+=P_-P_+=G.
Then
  (eta0 eta1 eta2 eta3) G^2
  (x0x1x2x3)^2
   =4x^2y^2.                                      (229BA.27)


Therefore eta0 eta1 eta2 eta3 is a square, so
  eps0+eps1+eps2+eps3 == 0 mod2,                  (229BA.28)
and, positively,
  sqrt(eta0 eta1 eta2 eta3)
  G x0x1x2x3
   =2xy.                                          (229BA.29)


RESULT_229BA_TOTAL_CENTRAL_2ADIC_PARITY_EVEN=PROVED_EXACT.


Also the root quadruple is primitive:
an odd common prime would contradict229AV cross-cluster coprimality; if all xj were even then all four central forms would be divisible by4, forcing e,R even, and then R^2-e^2=x^2+y^2 would force both physical x,y even, contradicting primitive physical gcd(e,x,y)=1.

  gcd(x0,x1,x2,x3)=1.                             (229BA.30)


RESULT_229BA_CENTRAL_ROOT_QUADRUPLE_PRIMITIVE=PROVED_EXACT.


The diagonal quadric
  eta0Q_-x0^2+eta1Q_+x1^2
   =eta2P_-x2^2+eta3P_+x3^2                       (229BA.31)
has square discriminant by (229BA.28), and every occupied coefficient tuple has a rational point by construction. Thus each occupied coefficient quadric is a split rational quadric.


This does NOT supply a uniform counting theorem by itself:
the available rational splitting point is part of the moving physical packet, and using it as a parametrization basepoint without a height adapter would be circular. Split quadrics also carry two-dimensional rational rulings.


RESULT_229BA_GENERIC_SPLIT_QUADRIC_GEOMETRY_ALONE=NO_COUNTING_CREDIT.

AR-010:
  the warning is now directly relevant. The generic moving-quadric formulation is not the minimal receiver because (229BA.23)-(229BA.26) reconstruct normalized endpoint quotients E0,R0 from the same root data. Future theorem matching should preserve this quotient rectangle.

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AZ — four-line CRT lattice and crossed matching joint root count


STATUS: POST_229AY_ROOT_LINE_NETWORK_COMPLETE / PROVED_SINGLE_4D_CRT_LATTICE_INDEX_EQUALS_GODD / PROVED_Q_MATCHING_AND_P_MATCHING_JOINT_ROOT_COUNTS / PROVED_FIXED_G_SAME_PHYSICAL_ROOT_SUPPORT_BOUND / IDENTIFIED_TWO_FREE_ROOT_FLOOR_AS_CURRENT_AR009_LIMIT / NO_COUNTING_PROMOTION / GLOBAL_GATE_UNCHANGED / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_GLOBAL_REOPEN


TYPE: POST-229AY JOINT ROOT-LINE LATTICE / EXACT CRT INDEX / CROSSED QP MATCHING COUNT / SAME-MEASURE AR009 NETWORK / QUANTITATIVE FIREWALL


OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY: M3-T11-229
LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION: M3-T11-228
PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA: Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AY
PRIMARY_GATE: M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN

GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT: 0
CARD_DOC_ID: 16ybqwIgy0dwyBM_nxKWIXoElTwC4WLx3j_gP_GQy8gI


1. Scope


This card continues the requested Arsenal re-evaluation by replacing four separate AR-009 line events with one exact same-measure lattice.


Retain 229AY notation:
  a=A_-,
  b=A_+,
  c=C_-,
  d=C_+,
which are pairwise coprime odd positive integers.


Retain central roots
  x0,x1,x2,x3
from
  lambda = eta0 a c x0^2,
  S      = eta1 b d x1^2,
  Lm     = eta2 a d x2^2,
  Lp     = eta3 b c x3^2.


Retain one charged orientation choice for each raw-power root line:
  x1 == rho_a x3 mod a,
  x0 == rho_b x2 mod b,
  x1 == rho_c x2 mod c,
  x0 == rho_d x3 mod d.                            (229AZ.1)


The total number of orientation choices is at most
  2^(omega(abcd)) = B^o(1).


Define
  G := abcd = (G_*)_odd,
and retain the 229AS crossed matchings
  Q_- = ac,
  Q_+ = bd,
  P_- = ad,
  P_+ = bc,
so
  Q_-Q_+ = P_-P_+ = G.                             (229AZ.2)


2. One four-dimensional CRT lattice


For fixed atom data and fixed orientations rho, define
  L_rho subset Z^4
by the four homogeneous congruences (229AZ.1).


Consider the homomorphism
  Phi: Z^4 -> Z/a x Z/b x Z/c x Z/d
given by
  Phi(x0,x1,x2,x3)
   = (x1-rho_a x3,
      x0-rho_b x2,
      x1-rho_c x2,
      x0-rho_d x3).                                (229AZ.3)


Phi is surjective.


Indeed, for arbitrary target residues:
- set x2=x3=0;
- choose x1 by CRT to hit independently the residues modulo a and c;
- choose x0 by CRT to hit independently the residues modulo b and d.


Pairwise coprimality of a,b,c,d is exactly the needed hypothesis.


Therefore
  L_rho = ker Phi
has exact lattice index
  [Z^4 : L_rho] = abcd = G.                        (229AZ.4)


RESULT_229AZ_FOUR_LINE_CRT_LATTICE_INDEX=GODD_PROVED_EXACT.


This is the correct joint interpretation of the four 229AY root lines. No multiplication of heuristic local densities is used.


3. Q-matching joint count


Let the four roots lie in positive intervals/dyadic boxes of lengths/scales
  X0,X1,X2,X3.


Fix x2 and x3.


The two congruences involving x1 are
  x1 == rho_a x3 mod a,
  x1 == rho_c x2 mod c.
By CRT there is exactly one residue class modulo
  ac=Q_-.


Hence the number of admissible x1 in its interval is
  O(1+X1/Q_-).


Likewise the two congruences involving x0 give exactly one residue class modulo
  bd=Q_+,
so there are
  O(1+X0/Q_+)
choices for x0.


Therefore
  N_rho(X)
   << X2 X3
      (1+X1/Q_-)
      (1+X0/Q_+).                                  (229AZ.5)


RESULT_229AZ_Q_MATCHING_JOINT_ROOT_COUNT=PROVED_EXACT.


This is a same-lattice joint count. The two Q moduli are not charged as independent endpoint probabilities.


4. P-matching joint count


Instead fix x0 and x1.


The two congruences determining x2 are
  x2 == rho_b^{-1} x0 mod b,
  x2 == rho_c^{-1} x1 mod c,
hence one residue class modulo
  bc=P_+.


The two congruences determining x3 give one residue class modulo
  ad=P_-.


Therefore
  N_rho(X)
   << X0 X1
      (1+X2/P_+)
      (1+X3/P_-).                                  (229AZ.6)


RESULT_229AZ_P_MATCHING_JOINT_ROOT_COUNT=PROVED_EXACT.


The swapped P signs are structural:
x2 belongs to the Lm coefficient P_- but is controlled modulo the opposite matching P_+;
x3 belongs to the Lp coefficient P_+ but is controlled modulo P_-.


5. Physical root-size input


The central forms are O(B). Therefore every nonempty dyadic root box satisfies
  Q_- X0^2 << B,
  Q_+ X1^2 << B,
  P_- X2^2 << B,
  P_+ X3^2 << B.                                  (229AZ.7)


Since Q_-Q_+=P_-P_+=G,
  X0 X1 << B/sqrt(G),
  X2 X3 << B/sqrt(G),                              (229AZ.8)
and
  X0X1X2X3 << B^2/G.                               (229AZ.9)


Insert these into (229AZ.5). After expansion,
  N_rho(X)
   << B/sqrt(G)
      + B^(3/2)/G * (Q_-^(-1/2)+Q_+^(-1/2))
      + B^2/G^2.                                   (229AZ.10)


Likewise (229AZ.6) gives
  N_rho(X)
   << B/sqrt(G)
      + B^(3/2)/G * (P_-^(-1/2)+P_+^(-1/2))
      + B^2/G^2.                                   (229AZ.11)


Thus one may take the better matching:
  N_rho(X)
   << B/sqrt(G)
      + B^(3/2)/G * M_QP
      + B^2/G^2,                                   (229AZ.12)
where
  M_QP :=
   min(
     Q_-^(-1/2)+Q_+^(-1/2),
     P_-^(-1/2)+P_+^(-1/2)
   ).


RESULT_229AZ_CROSSED_MATCHING_QUANTITATIVE_BOUND=PROVED_EXACT_UP_TO_ABSOLUTE_DYADIC_CONSTANTS.


All omitted physical equations and the exact additive central-form relation only reduce this root count.


6. Fixed-G same-physical count


Fix an odd raw content value
  G=(G_*)_odd.


Because a,b,c,d are pairwise coprime with product G, the number of ordered atom allocations is at most
  4^omega(G)=G^o(1).


The dyadic decomposition and four root-orientation choices together cost B^o(1).


Retain 229AY that the seven-coordinate central-root support has physical fiber at most 16.


Therefore the number of positive primitive physical endpoints with a fixed value G and lying in a fixed root-size range obeys the same bound (229AZ.12) up to B^o(1).


In particular, discarding matching balance,
  N_G(B)
   << B^o(1)
      [ B/sqrt(G)
        + B^(3/2)/G
        + B^2/G^2 ].                               (229AZ.13)


RESULT_229AZ_FIXED_RAW_G_SAME_PHYSICAL_COUNT=PROVED_SCOPED.


This is a genuine endpoint-side fixed-G estimate. It is not yet summable with the strength needed for the global one-third gate.


7. Why this improves the route but does not close it


229AY supplied four individual high-core AR-009 collapses.


229AZ shows that one can do better conceptually:
- all four congruences live in one exact index-G lattice;
- the Q and P crossed matchings are two complementary CRT coordinatizations of that same lattice;
- density is never multiplied across different measures;
- fixed-G atom allocation and orientation costs are only B^o(1).


However the terms
  B/sqrt(G)
and
  B^(3/2)/G
in (229AZ.13) remain too large at the preferred threshold
  sf(G_*) > B^(1/3-delta).


Moreover summing the fixed-G bound over all possible moving G values is not controlled by (229AZ.13) alone.


Thus:
  AR009_NETWORK_REENTRY = GENUINE,
  GLOBAL_ONE_THIRD_GATE_CLOSED = false.


8. The precise new blocker


The leading term
  B/sqrt(G)
comes from leaving two central roots free after the CRT lattice has determined the other two modulo Q or P.


But every physical root tuple also satisfies the exact central additive equation
  eta0 Q_- x0^2
  + eta1 Q_+ x1^2
  =
  eta2 P_- x2^2
  + eta3 P_+ x3^2.                                (229AZ.14)


Equation (229AZ.14) was not used in the lattice count.


Therefore the next non-looping quantitative target is now sharply identified:


  count lattice points of L_rho
  on the exact diagonal quadric (229AZ.14)
  in the physical dyadic root box,
  uniformly in moving pairwise-coprime a,b,c,d,
  while preserving the exact R<=B reconstruction.


A theorem that only reuses the determinant/index G and ignores (229AZ.14) cannot remove the two-free-root floor already visible in (229AZ.13).


RESULT_229AZ_CURRENT_BLOCKER=CRT_LATTICE_INTERSECT_EXACT_MOVING_SPLIT_QUADRIC.


9. Arsenal reassessment consequence


AR-009:
  upgraded from four isolated high-core lines to an exact four-line index-G lattice with joint Q/P counts.


AR-018:
  orientation data are charged once globally through rho_a,rho_b,rho_c,rho_d; no second saving is assigned.


S37-PW01:
  229AY constant-fiber root support transfers any valid count on the lattice/quadric support back to physical endpoints with O(1) multiplicity.


S36-PW07:
  229AY all-odd character matrix remains an additional necessary support filter on the same atom data.


S34-W01/W03:
  still not automatically triggered by (229AZ.14), because coefficients/atom squareclasses move. They become relevant only if a finite exact branch reduction of the moving quadric packet is obtained.


S35-PW04:
  remains not triggered by 229AY's ratio identities; no strict iff coordinate compression has been produced.


10. Preferred next input after the review


Priority A:
  moving-coefficient diagonal-quadric lattice count for (229AZ.14) inside L_rho, with a bound strong enough after summing atom data to beat B^(1/3).


Priority B:
  exact parameterization/factorization of (229AZ.14) that respects L_rho and reduces the two-free-root floor without enlarging the physical population.

Priority D:
  theorem search only through S37-WF02 with exact variables
    (a,b,c,d,x0,x1,x2,x3),
  determinant/index G,
  diagonal coefficients eta0Q_-,eta1Q_+,eta2P_-,eta3P_+,
  and physical height R<=B.

Do not:

- count arbitrary index-G lattice points and call them physical endpoints without the constant-fiber source map;
- sum (229AZ.13) over G and claim a tail bound without an actual summation theorem;
- forget the moving diagonal quadric (229AZ.14);
- replace raw G by sf(G) in the lattice determinant;
- infer independence from the two Q/P coordinatizations, since they are the same lattice;
- reopen S34/S35 routes merely from factor-shape similarity.

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AY — central atom all-prime local square-root matrix and root-line Arsenal reentry


STATUS: POST_229AX_ARSENAL_REVIEW_CONTINUED / PROVED_THREE_ROOT_CONSTANT_FIBER_SUPPORT / PROVED_FOUR_RAW_ATOM_POWER_MODULUS_ROOT_LINES / PROVED_ALL_ODD_PRIME_CHARACTER_ROWS_INCLUDING_INERT_EDGE_PRIMES / PROVED_S36_PW07_NONREDUNDANT_REENTRY / PROVED_AR009_FIBERWISE_HIGH_CORE_REENTRY / LOW_CORE_GLOBAL_COUNT_OPEN / NO_COUNTING_PROMOTION / GLOBAL_GATE_UNCHANGED / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_GLOBAL_REOPEN


TYPE: POST-229AX ARSENAL REASSESSMENT / CENTRAL ROOT SUPPORT COMPRESSION / FOUR-RESERVOIR LOCAL SQUARE-ROOT MATRIX / RAW-POWER ROOT-LINE ROUTER / METHOD FIREWALL


OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY: M3-T11-229
LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION: M3-T11-228
PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA: Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AX
PRIMARY_GATE: M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN
M3_T11_230: NOT ISSUED
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT: 0
CARD_DOC_ID: 1jzJiRyGo8aua_AoFuXxA1EOp3RuFlErx-Wm-QOrhAXw


1. Scope


This card performs the first requested post-229AX Arsenal re-check rather than continuing identity generation blindly.


Primary Arsenal inputs:
- S36-PW07 DIRECTIONAL_PRIME_RESERVOIR_LOCAL_CHARACTER_MATRIX;
- AR-009 Gaussian/root-line determinant spacing;
- S37-PW01 exact support pushforward;
- S37-WF02 quantitative budget firewall.


Retain the four central forms
  lambda = U+V-R-e,
  S      = e+U+V+R,
  Lm     = e+U+V-R,
  Lp     = R+U+V-e.


Retain 229AV full integer packet-times-square normal forms. Introduce canonical one-bit dyadic factors eta_j in {1,2} and positive integer roots
  x0,x1,x2,x3
such that
  lambda = eta0 A_- C_- x0^2,
  S      = eta1 A_+ C_+ x1^2,
  Lm     = eta2 A_- C_+ x2^2,
  Lp     = eta3 A_+ C_- x3^2.                    (229AY.1)


Here eta_j=2^(v2(form_j) mod 2). These are the central-form canonical 2-adic squareclass bits themselves; no superseded 229AF raw-gap parity identification is used.


Retain that A_-,A_+,C_-,C_+ are pairwise coprime odd positive integers.


2. A stricter S37-PW01 support with constant physical fibers


Define the seven-coordinate realized support
  Xi_B
   = {(A_-,A_+,C_-,C_+,x0,x1,x2)
      arising from positive primitive physical endpoints R<=B}.     (229AY.2)


Fix one tuple in Xi_B.


For each of the at most 2^3 choices
  (eta0,eta1,eta2) in {1,2}^3,
the three central forms lambda,S,Lm are fixed by (229AY.1).


The fourth central form is forced by the exact additive rectangle:
  lambda + S = Lm + Lp,
so
  Lp = lambda + S - Lm.                            (229AY.3)


The physical variables are then reconstructed exactly as
  e = (Lm-lambda)/2,
  R = (S-Lm)/2,
  U+V = (lambda+S)/2,
  UV = eR + lambda*S/2.                            (229AY.4)


Thus U,V are the roots of one quadratic polynomial and have at most two ordered choices. For each ordered pair, positivity forces
  x = sqrt(U^2-e^2),
  y = sqrt(V^2-e^2)
when these are positive integers.


Therefore
  # fiber(Xi_B -> physical endpoints) <= 16.         (229AY.5)


RESULT_229AY_THREE_ROOT_SUPPORT_CONSTANT_PHYSICAL_FIBER=PROVED_EXACT.


Consequently
  P(B) <= 16 #Xi_B.                                 (229AY.6)


This is a strict support-side refinement of 229AX: it replaces the B^o(1) factorization fiber of the rank-one T-matrix support by a seven-coordinate central-root support with an absolute constant physical fiber. No claim is made that #Xi_B is small.


3. Exact additive rectangle


Retain the four exact differences
  Lm-lambda = 2e,
  S-Lp      = 2e,
  Lp-lambda = 2R,
  S-Lm      = 2R.                                  (229AY.7)


The complete 229AV K4 odd-gcd graph implies:
- A_- is the exact odd gcd edge lambda--Lm and is coprime to S,Lp;
- A_+ is the exact odd gcd edge S--Lp and is coprime to lambda,Lm;
- C_- is the exact odd gcd edge lambda--Lp and is coprime to S,Lm;
- C_+ is the exact odd gcd edge S--Lm and is coprime to lambda,Lp.


Hence the two central roots on the opposite side of any atom are units modulo that full raw atom.


4. Raw-power root line modulo A_-


Because A_- divides e, (229AY.7) gives
  S == Lp mod A_-.


Insert (229AY.1):
  eta1 A_+ C_+ x1^2
    == eta3 A_+ C_- x3^2 mod A_-.


Since A_+C_-C_+x1x3 is invertible mod A_-,
  (x1/x3)^2
    == eta3 eta1^{-1} C_- C_+^{-1} mod A_-.       (229AY.8)


The right side is therefore a unit square modulo A_- on every physical point.


For each prime power p^k || A_-, there are exactly two square roots of this unit modulo p^k. By CRT, after one orientation choice among at most
  2^omega(A_-)=B^o(1)
possibilities,
  x1 == rho_{A-} x3 mod A_-,                       (229AY.9)
where
  rho_{A-}^2
   == eta3 eta1^{-1} C_- C_+^{-1} mod A_-.


RESULT_229AY_A_MINUS_RAW_POWER_ROOT_LINE=PROVED_EXACT.


5. The other three raw-power root lines


The same argument on the other three atom edges gives:


A_+:
  lambda == Lm mod A_+,
  x0 == rho_{A+} x2 mod A_+,                       (229AY.10)
  rho_{A+}^2
   == eta2 eta0^{-1} C_+ C_-^{-1} mod A_+.


C_-:
  S == Lm mod C_-,
  x1 == rho_{C-} x2 mod C_-,                       (229AY.11)
  rho_{C-}^2
   == eta2 eta1^{-1} A_- A_+^{-1} mod C_-.


C_+:
  lambda == Lp mod C_+,
  x0 == rho_{C+} x3 mod C_+,                       (229AY.12)
  rho_{C+}^2
   == eta3 eta0^{-1} A_+ A_-^{-1} mod C_+.


All inverses are legitimate because the four atoms are pairwise coprime and the opposite roots are units on the corresponding modulus.


RESULT_229AY_FOUR_RAW_ATOM_POWER_ROOT_LINES=PROVED_EXACT.


This is stronger than a squarefree-radical congruence: the complete raw p-adic exponent of each atom is retained as the modulus.


6. All-odd rational character matrix


Let eps_j in F2 be defined by eta_j=2^eps_j.


Taking Legendre symbols in (229AY.8)-(229AY.12) gives the following necessary rows for every odd prime p in the stated atom support:


p | A_-:
  (C_- C_+ / p)
   = (2/p)^(eps1+eps3).                             (229AY.13)


p | A_+:
  (C_- C_+ / p)
   = (2/p)^(eps0+eps2).                             (229AY.14)

7. Why this is not a relabeling of 229AE-AG

  Delta0, Delta+, Delta-

  kA=kA_-kA_+,

  (2/kA_+)^(eps0+eps2)

  T_{--}=u_-v_-,
  T_{-+}=u_-v_+,
  T_{+-}=u_+v_-,

More precisely,

   =T_{-+}T_{+-}
   =u_-u_+v_-v_+

Retain the central linear forms
  lambda = U+V-R-e,
  S      = e+U+V+R,
  L_-    = e+U+V-R,

  A_- = gcd_odd(e,lambda),

  lambda S = 2^(epsilon_macro+1) G_* r_-^2,
  L_- L_+  = 2^(epsilon_macro+1) G_* r_+^2,

2. Finite 2-adic normalization


For any positive integer N with
  O(N)=Q w^2
and Q odd, write nu=v_2(N). Then
  N = eta Q W^2,
where
  eta=2^(nu mod 2) in {1,2},

  eta_lambda, eta_S, eta_Lm, eta_Lp in {1,2}

  delta_Q := gcd(u_-,u_+),

  L_- - lambda = 2e,
  L_+ - lambda = 2R,
  S - L_-      = 2R,
  S - L_+      = 2e.

  gcd_odd(lambda,L_-) = gcd_odd(lambda,e) = A_-,
  gcd_odd(lambda,L_+) = gcd_odd(lambda,R) = C_-,

  {lambda,S,L_-,L_+}.

  O(L_-)O(L_+)

    = (G_*)_odd (v_-v_+)^2,


while 229AR gives
  O(L_-L_+)
    = (G_*)_odd O(r_+)^2.


Therefore
  v_-v_+ = O(r_+).                                 (229AV.8)


RESULT_229AV_PLUS_MACRO_ROOT_FACTORIZATION=PROVED_EXACT.


Thus the low-height square-cofactor roots are not auxiliary artifacts:
- the lambda/S roots multiply to the odd part of the macro minus Euclid root;
- the L_-/L_+ roots multiply to the odd part of the macro plus Euclid root.


This is the exact bridge between the 229AU low-height receiver and the 229AR no-threshold-loss macro receiver.


6. Cross-cluster coprimality


229AR gives gcd(r_-,r_+)=1. Hence
  gcd(O(r_-),O(r_+))=1.


Using (229AV.7)-(229AV.8),
  gcd(u_-u_+, v_-v_+)=1.                           (229AV.9)


Consequently every u-root is coprime to every v-root:
  gcd(u_sigma,v_tau)=1 for all sigma,tau in {-,+}. (229AV.10)


In particular
  gcd(delta_Q,delta_P)=1.                           (229AV.11)


Retain 229AU that delta_Q|d0 and delta_P|d0. Thus the two square common-gcd roots occupy disjoint odd prime support inside d0.


RESULT_229AV_MACRO_ROOT_CLUSTER_COPRIMALITY=PROVED_EXACT.

  lambda S L_- L_+
    = 4[(UV)^2-(eR)^2].


Retain the macro Pythagorean identity
  (eR)^2+(xy)^2=(UV)^2.
Therefore
  lambda S L_- L_+ = 4x^2y^2.                     (229AV.12)

This identifies the four low-height square roots as a complete multiplicative factorization of the odd primitive macro-leg cofactor xy/G_*.

    odd packet Q_-=A_-C_-,

  vertex S:
    odd packet Q_+=A_+C_+,

  Y_+ := O(L_+)/P_+,
and
  h_1 := sf(Y_-)=sf(Y_+).


Any prime p|h_1 divides both L_- and L_+, hence by 229AS
  h_1 | rad(d0).                                           (229AU.5)


Thus
  Y_- = h_1 v_-^2,
  Y_+ = h_1 v_+^2                                         (229AU.6)
for positive integers v_-,v_+.


5. Cross-gap identity forces h_0=h_1


Retain the exact 229AQ identity
  lambda L_- = 2(R-U)(R-V).                               (229AU.7)


On the right, using the exact physical Pythagorean gap forms,
  sf_odd((R-U)(R-V)) = sf_odd(c12 c21)
                     = sf(C_- C_+),                       (229AU.8)
where 229AS gives C_-C_+=(c12c21)_odd.


On the left, 229AS gives
  Q_- = A_- C_-,
  P_- = A_- C_+,
so
  Q_- P_- = A_-^2 C_- C_+.                                (229AU.9)


Substituting (229AU.3) and (229AU.6) into the odd squareclass of (229AU.7), the Q_-P_- contribution has exactly the same odd squareclass as C_-C_+, while h_0,h_1 are supported on d0 and are coprime to G_* by gcd(eR,d0)=1. Hence
  sf(h_0 h_1)=1.


Since h_0,h_1 are squarefree,
  h_0 = h_1.                                               (229AU.10)


6. The common nuisance squareclass is trivial


Write h:=h_0=h_1.


If an odd prime p|h, then p divides both lambda and L_- by construction. But
  L_- - lambda = 2e.
Hence p|e.


On the other hand h|rad(d0), so p|d0. This contradicts gcd(e,d0)=1 (indeed 229O gives gcd(eR,d0)=1).


Therefore
  h=1.                                                     (229AU.11)


RESULT_229AU_COMMON_d0_SQUARECLASS_NUISANCE_COLLAPSE=PROVED_EXACT.


7. Exact raw-packet-times-square factorization


From h=1:
  O(lambda) = Q_- u_-^2,
  O(S)      = Q_+ u_+^2,
  O(L_-)    = P_- v_-^2,
  O(L_+)    = P_+ v_+^2.                                  (229AU.12)


Equivalently,
  O(lambda)/gcd_odd(eR,lambda) is a square,
  O(S)/gcd_odd(eR,S) is a square,
  O(L_-)/gcd_odd(eR,L_-) is a square,
  O(L_+)/gcd_odd(eR,L_+) is a square.                      (229AU.13)


RESULT_229AU_FOUR_CENTRAL_LINEAR_RAW_PACKET_SQUARE_QUOTIENTS=PROVED_EXACT.


This is stronger than the 229AS statement that the pairwise common odd gcds merely divide d0^2.


8. Squarefree-kernel transfer


Taking odd squarefree kernels in (229AU.12),
  sf_odd(lambda)=sf(Q_-),
  sf_odd(S)=sf(Q_+),
  sf_odd(L_-)=sf(P_-),
  sf_odd(L_+)=sf(P_+).                                    (229AU.14)


Thus the 229AS low-height packets can be read directly as the odd squarefree kernels of four O(B) central linear forms, with an exact square cofactor after removing the raw packet.


In particular the 229AS simultaneous half-threshold consequence may be rewritten without loss:
if K_*>T, then in the Q matching one of sf_odd(lambda),sf_odd(S) exceeds (T/2)^(1/2), and in the P matching one of sf_odd(L_-),sf_odd(L_+) exceeds (T/2)^(1/2).


At T=B^(1/3-delta), the same B^(1/6-delta/2) packet threshold is preserved.


RESULT_229AU_CENTRAL_LINEAR_SQUAREFREE_KERNEL_TRANSFER=PROVED_EXACT.


9. Pairwise central gcds are squares


From (229AU.12), gcd(Q_-,Q_+)=1, and the 229AS d0-firewall excluding cross G_*-support, no prime of Q_- can divide u_+ and no prime of Q_+ can divide u_-.


Therefore
  gcd_odd(lambda,S)=gcd(u_-,u_+)^2.                        (229AU.15)


Likewise
  gcd_odd(L_-,L_+)=gcd(v_-,v_+)^2.                         (229AU.16)


Hence both central-pair odd gcds are perfect squares; their square roots divide d0.


RESULT_229AU_CENTRAL_PAIR_ODD_GCDS_ARE_SQUARES=PROVED_EXACT.


10. Relation to 229AT and current theorem interface


229AT supplied opposite-content Euclid-root divisibility. 229AU supplies a different exact normalization of the same low-height raw-G packets:
  central linear form = exact raw packet × square × 2-adic factor.


This removes the remaining d0 squareclass nuisance from the 229AS theorem-matching surface.

for some fixed delta>0.

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AT — checkerboard packet crosswalk and reciprocal opposite-content Euclid-root coupling


STATUS: POST_229AS_CHECKERBOARD_CROSSWALK_COMPLETE / PROVED_AS_EDGE_ATOMS_ARE_AP_SIGN_PARITY_AGGREGATES / PROVED_SPACE_CONTENT_CENTRAL_SIGN_SPLIT / PROVED_FOUR_ATOMIC_OPPOSITE_GAP_SQUARE_CARRIERS / PROVED_RECIPROCAL_OPPOSITE_CONTENT_EUCLID_ROOT_DIVISIBILITY / PROVED_EIGHT_SIGNED_CONTENT_ROOT_INEQUALITIES / NO_COUNTING_PROMOTION / GLOBAL_GATE_UNCHANGED / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_REOPEN


TYPE: POST-229AS SIGN-PACKET CROSSWALK / RECIPROCAL CONTENT-ROOT COUPLING / OPPOSITE-TRIANGLE SQUARE-DIVISOR ADAPTER / METHOD FIREWALL


OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY: M3-T11-229
LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION: M3-T11-228
PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA: Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AS
PRIMARY_GATE: M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN
M3_T11_230: NOT ISSUED
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT: 0
CARD_DOC_ID: 1VA2yufJ08wWtkorKE9WQe_lH6tuqYp0apB-B-j84VYg


1. Scope


229AS gives four pairwise-coprime odd raw-content atoms
  A_-=gcd_odd(e,lambda),
  A_+=gcd_odd(e,S),
  C_-=gcd_odd(R,lambda),
  C_+=gcd_odd(R,S),
with
  (ab)_odd=A_-A_+,
  (c12c21)_odd=C_-C_+,
  (G_*)_odd=A_-A_+C_-C_+.


229AP gives eight pairwise-coprime sign-resolved all-odd edge packets
  alpha_{sigma,tau} for a_odd,
  beta_{sigma,tau} for b_odd,
and 229AM gives the forced third-gap law
  alpha_{sigma,tau}^2 | R-sigma*tau U,
  beta_{sigma,tau}^2  | R-sigma*tau V.


This card identifies the exact checkerboard map from the 229AP sign matrix into the 229AS edge atoms A_±. It then constructs the analogous central-sign split of c12,c21 and proves a reciprocal divisibility cycle: every signed content piece divides an Euclid root cofactor of the opposite physical Pythagorean content family.


The new information is not an extra independent local condition. It is a same-physical cross-content coupling intended as a stronger theorem interface.


2. Retained notation


Retain
  lambda=U+V-R-e,
  S=e+U+V+R.


For sigma,tau in {-,+}, retain 229AP:
  alpha_{sigma,tau}^2
    =gcd_odd(U+sigma x,R+tau x),
  beta_{sigma,tau}^2
    =gcd_odd(V+sigma y,R+tau y),
with
  a_odd=product_{sigma,tau} alpha_{sigma,tau},
  b_odd=product_{sigma,tau} beta_{sigma,tau},
and all eight alpha/beta packets pairwise coprime.


Define the sign-parity aggregates
  a_diag := alpha_{-,-} alpha_{+,+},
  a_off  := alpha_{-,+} alpha_{+,-},
  b_diag := beta_{-,-} beta_{+,+},
  b_off  := beta_{-,+} beta_{+,-}.                (229AT.1)


Thus
  a_odd=a_diag a_off,
  b_odd=b_diag b_off.                              (229AT.2)


Here “diag” means sigma*tau=+1 and “off” means sigma*tau=-1.


3. Exact checkerboard crosswalk: A_- and A_+


Let p^k be carried by alpha_{sigma,tau}. Then p^k|a, hence p^k|e and p^k|V.


Retain 229AM:
  alpha_{sigma,tau}^2 | R-sigma*tau U.            (229AT.3)


If sigma*tau=+1, then p^k|R-U. Since p^k also divides V-e,
  lambda=(U-R)+(V-e)
is divisible by p^k. Therefore the whole alpha diagonal packet divides A_-.


If sigma*tau=-1, then p^k|R+U. Since p^k also divides V+e,
  S=(R+U)+(V+e)
is divisible by p^k. Therefore the whole alpha off-diagonal packet divides A_+.


The beta side is identical: p^k|b implies p^k|e,U, and 229AM gives
  beta_{sigma,tau}^2 | R-sigma*tau V.
Hence beta diagonal packets divide A_- and beta off-diagonal packets divide A_+.


Thus
  a_diag b_diag | A_-,
  a_off  b_off  | A_+.                            (229AT.4)


But 229AS gives the coprime exact factorization
  A_-A_+=(ab)_odd,
while (229AT.2) gives
  (ab)_odd=a_diag a_off b_diag b_off.
All factors involved are pairwise coprime. Therefore
  A_- = a_diag b_diag
      = alpha_{-,-} alpha_{+,+} beta_{-,-} beta_{+,+},  (229AT.5)
  A_+ = a_off b_off
      = alpha_{-,+} alpha_{+,-} beta_{-,+} beta_{+,-}.  (229AT.6)


RESULT_229AT_AS_EDGE_ATOMS_ARE_AP_CHECKERBOARD_AGGREGATES=PROVED_EXACT.


Thus the 229AS central sign on the e-side is exactly the parity sigma*tau of the 229AP two-sign packet.


4. Edge atoms square-divide opposite space-gap products


From 229AM:
  alpha_{-,-}^2 | R-U,
  alpha_{+,+}^2 | R-U,
  alpha_{-,+}^2 | R+U,
  alpha_{+,-}^2 | R+U.


Since the alpha packets are pairwise coprime,
  a_diag^2 | R-U,
  a_off^2  | R+U.                                 (229AT.7)


Similarly
  b_diag^2 | R-V,
  b_off^2  | R+V.                                 (229AT.8)


Using (229AT.5)-(229AT.6),
  A_-^2 | (R-U)(R-V),                             (229AT.9)
  A_+^2 | (R+U)(R+V).                             (229AT.10)


RESULT_229AT_EDGE_ATOM_MINUS_SQUARE_CARRIER=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229AT_EDGE_ATOM_PLUS_SQUARE_CARRIER=PROVED_EXACT.


This also recovers directly from the 229AQ/229AS linear identities:
  lambda L_- = 2(R-U)(R-V),
  S L_+      = 2(R+U)(R+V),
because A_- divides both e and lambda, while A_+ divides both e and S.


5. Central sign split of the two space contents


Define
  c12,- := gcd(c12_odd,C_-),
  c12,+ := gcd(c12_odd,C_+),
  c21,- := gcd(c21_odd,C_-),
  c21,+ := gcd(c21_odd,C_+).                      (229AT.11)


Because c12,c21 are coprime and 229AS gives
  C_-C_+=(c12c21)_odd
with gcd(C_-,C_+)=1,
we have exact pairwise-coprime decompositions
  c12_odd = c12,- c12,+,
  c21_odd = c21,- c21,+,                         (229AT.12)
  C_- = c12,- c21,-,
  C_+ = c12,+ c21,+.                              (229AT.13)


RESULT_229AT_SPACE_CONTENT_CENTRAL_SIGN_SPLIT=PROVED_EXACT.


6. Space atoms square-divide opposite edge-gap products


Take an odd prime p^k||c12,-. Then p^k divides the content c12 of the Pythagorean triple
  (U,y,R),
so p^k|U,R,y.
Also p^k|C_- implies p^k|lambda.


First p does not divide e. Otherwise p|U and p|e would force p|x from
  U^2-e^2=x^2;
together with p|y this would contradict primitive physical gcd(e,x,y)=1.


Now
  lambda=(U-R)+(V-e).
Since p^k|U-R and p^k|lambda,
  p^k|V-e.


Because
  (V-e)(V+e)=y^2
and p does not divide e, the odd prime p cannot divide both V-e and V+e. Hence
  v_p(V-e)=2v_p(y)>=2k.
Therefore
  (c12,-)^2 | V-e.                                (229AT.14)


The same argument with S=(U+R)+(V+e) gives
  (c12,+)^2 | V+e.                                (229AT.15)


Likewise, for the content c21 of (V,x,R),
  (c21,-)^2 | U-e,
  (c21,+)^2 | U+e.                                (229AT.16)


Multiplying the coprime factors,
  C_-^2 | (U-e)(V-e),                             (229AT.17)
  C_+^2 | (U+e)(V+e).                             (229AT.18)


RESULT_229AT_SPACE_ATOM_MINUS_SQUARE_CARRIER=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229AT_SPACE_ATOM_PLUS_SQUARE_CARRIER=PROVED_EXACT.


These also match the complementary 229AQ identities
  lambda L_+ = 2(U-e)(V-e),
  S L_-      = 2(U+e)(V+e).


7. Euclid-root cofactor normalization


For each physical Pythagorean triple, primitive Euclid parameterization gives the same 2-adic orientation on its minus and plus gaps. Hence there exist bits
  rho_b,rho_a,rho_12,rho_21 in {0,1}
and positive coprime-in-the-usual-Euclid-sense root factors
  s_{b,-},s_{b,+},
  s_{a,-},s_{a,+},
  s_{12,-},s_{12,+},
  s_{21,-},s_{21,+}
such that
  U-e = 2^rho_b  b   s_{b,-}^2,
  U+e = 2^rho_b  b   s_{b,+}^2,                  (229AT.19)
  V-e = 2^rho_a  a   s_{a,-}^2,
  V+e = 2^rho_a  a   s_{a,+}^2,                  (229AT.20)
  R-U = 2^rho_12 c12 s_{12,-}^2,
  R+U = 2^rho_12 c12 s_{12,+}^2,                 (229AT.21)
  R-V = 2^rho_21 c21 s_{21,-}^2,
  R+V = 2^rho_21 c21 s_{21,+}^2.                 (229AT.22)


The edge packets are odd and the four physical contents a,b,c12,c21 are pairwise coprime. Therefore (229AT.7)-(229AT.8) sharpen to
  a_diag | s_{12,-},
  a_off  | s_{12,+},
  b_diag | s_{21,-},
  b_off  | s_{21,+}.                              (229AT.23)


Likewise (229AT.14)-(229AT.16) sharpen to
  c12,- | s_{a,-},
  c12,+ | s_{a,+},
  c21,- | s_{b,-},
  c21,+ | s_{b,+}.                                (229AT.24)


Equivalently at the aggregate level,
  A_- | s_{12,-} s_{21,-},
  A_+ | s_{12,+} s_{21,+},
  C_- | s_{a,-} s_{b,-},
  C_+ | s_{a,+} s_{b,+}.                          (229AT.25)


RESULT_229AT_RECIPROCAL_OPPOSITE_CONTENT_EUCLID_ROOT_DIVISIBILITY=PROVED_EXACT.


This is the central new coupling:
- signed edge content divides Euclid roots of the opposite space-content gaps;
- signed space content divides Euclid roots of the opposite edge-content gaps.


The two physical pairs are reciprocal:
  a_diag/off <-> c12,-/+,
  b_diag/off <-> c21,-/+.


8. Exact size inequalities


The root divisibilities imply the following deterministic inequalities:
  a_diag^2 c12 <= R-U,
  a_off^2  c12 <= R+U,                            (229AT.26)
  b_diag^2 c21 <= R-V,
  b_off^2  c21 <= R+V,                            (229AT.27)
  (c12,-)^2 a <= V-e,
  (c12,+)^2 a <= V+e,                             (229AT.28)
  (c21,-)^2 b <= U-e,
  (c21,+)^2 b <= U+e.                             (229AT.29)


In particular
  A_-^2 (c12c21)_odd <= (R-U)(R-V),               (229AT.30)
  C_-^2 (ab)_odd     <= (U-e)(V-e),               (229AT.31)
up to harmless omission of even content factors on the left; the displayed inequalities are valid because the right sides contain the full raw contents and the additional odd square divisors.


RESULT_229AT_EIGHT_SIGNED_CONTENT_ROOT_HEIGHT_INEQUALITIES=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229AT_SHORT_GAP_CROSS_CONTENT_HEIGHT_COUPLING=PROVED_EXACT.


9. Relation to the current hard remainder


229AQ already disposes
  (R-U)(R-V) <= B^(1/3-eta)
at o(B^(1/3)) cost for every fixed eta>0.


229AT shows that in the complementary hard remainder:
- a large A_- is not merely a large gcd atom; its square is embedded in the outer short-gap product and its signed a/b pieces divide the corresponding space Euclid roots;
- a large C_- is reciprocally embedded in the inner short-gap product and its c12/c21 pieces divide the corresponding edge Euclid roots.


Thus a future count can condition simultaneously on:
  raw content size,
  central sign,
  opposite Euclid-root divisibility,
  exact physical R-height,
without inventing an additional independent local condition.


No endpoint estimate is proved here.

- infer a global saving from the deterministic size inequalities alone;

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AS — crossed low-height raw-G gcd matchings and d0-square nuisance firewall


STATUS: POST_229AR_CROSSED_LOW_HEIGHT_RAW_G_GCD_MATCHINGS_COMPLETE / PROVED_CENTRAL_AND_SHIFTED_COMMON_GCD_NUISANCE_LIVES_IN_d0_SQUARED / PROVED_TWO_EXACT_COPRIME_RAW_G_ODD_MATCHINGS / PROVED_FOUR_ATOMIC_LINEAR_LINEAR_GCD_BUCKETS / PROVED_EDGE_AND_SPACE_RAW_CONTENT_SPLIT_BY_CENTRAL_SIGN / PROVED_SIMULTANEOUS_TWO_MATCHING_HALF_THRESHOLD / DEPENDENCE_FIREWALL_NO_DENSITY_MULTIPLICATION / GLOBAL_GATE_UNCHANGED / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_REOPEN
